description.value:
Check Crafting against a DC set by the GM

Ten minutes, a multitool, and a refusal to accept what the gun has told you.

Attempt a field repair on a firearm you are holding. On a success you clear a jammed weapon, or restore one rarity step lost to the Something cracks result until the end of the scene; on a critical success you do both, and the restored step lasts until your next daily preparations. On a critical failure the weapon is dead for the rest of the scene — which, being a Trick Iron, is a thing you can spend.

cinderfall.incomplete: no selector for skill-check-gated item-state restoration.
